d:
Long, flowing silk-white hair with straight-cut bangs and a smooth texture. Sharp, narrow almond-shaped eyes of a deep crimson shade. An adolescent appearance with a mature, stoic expression. A slender, athletic build. A traditional red and white Japanese-style kimono with wide sleeves and a black obi sash. A signature long red katana and a small red ribbon tied to the hair.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
